verdict.rationale: Featurebase's marketing/docs describe hosted, brandable pages (custom domain changelog, embeddable widgets, Notion-like editor) that imply a PM-friendly, no-code setup, but none of the evidence explicitly confirms the feedback board/portal itself is self-serve or code-free, only the changelog piece is documented this way. missing for 10: explicit documentation of feedback-board portal creation flow, confirmation no engineering/dev resources are needed, independent user testimony of a PM setting it up solo.
